A '''Neimoidian''' was a historic figure in [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] society.

==Biography==
The Neimoidian was significant enough to be granted a portrait, which displayed the individual posed in front of a golden background. This artwork came to hang in a gallery within [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod's]] [[Lott Dod's palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].
